title: Onion Soup
ingredients: One large onion – sliced very thinly
1 pint (or a bit more) very rich beef stock
Garlic (lots – either 2 teaspoons of dried or about 5 cloves chopped)
method: Heat olive oil and butter in large frying pan and add onions, garlic and sugar when very hot.
Fry on high heat until onions are well browned (not burnt) then put on very low heat for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add stock and bring to boil.
Any oil residue may need to be skimmed off.Season as required.
